briefdescription.para: Terminal edit operations for the VT video processor: erase, insert, delete, scroll.

detaileddescription.para: This file implements the screen-editing subsystem of the Video class. It covers all operations that modify the content of the Grid without moving the cursor to a new position: erasing regions, inserting and deleting lines, inserting and deleting characters within a line, and switching between the normal and alternate screen buffers.
All operations write directly to the Grid cell buffer on the reader thread.

entry.para: Erase part or all of screen
Erase part or all of line

simplesect.para: All functions in this file run on the READER THREAD only.
